links.surface: أبو صالح عبد الله بن صالح

notes: the opening «قال» carries on an earlier narration whose speaker the text does not name, so no link is added before عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن
«بهذا الحديث» ends the first route; «وروى مالك» starts a second isnad with no saying between, so it is a second group
«قال أبو عيسى» and «قال محمد» paragraphs are comments (the second names al-Bukhari's view), not routes; «بينما عمر بن الخطاب يخطب» is the story's subject, not a link
